changelog:
Initial release — generates compliant SWMS documents for Australian construction projects.

- Creates Safe Work Method Statements for all 19 high-risk construction work categories under Australian WHS Regulations.
- Applies the WHS Act 2011 hierarchy of controls and a comprehensive hazard library.
- Collects project and site-specific details via structured intake questions before SWMS generation.
- Produces site-specific, not generic, SWMS documents.
- Suitable for builders, subcontractors, and principal contractors needing WHS compliance.
